objective: Collect and read completely the public material on how top Kaggle participants run agentic research workflows, and store it as sourced files for later use. Research only: no models, no experiments, no Kaggle submission, no changes to existing code, no changes to the NotebookLM notebook.
constraints: No model-generated text is ever stored as a source
No Kaggle submission or code execution
No upgrading of the kaggle CLI
nonGoals: Do not train or run machine learning models

decisions.answer: Playground Series s6e11 topic 756276, KGMON-Playbook-2026 repo, and reachable S6E9/S6E8/S6E5/S6E3 threads
